effect_description_eng:
While you have an [Armor Form] trait Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn, and all of your opponent's Digimon get -1000 DP for the turn for each card with the [Armor Form] trait in your trash.
